name: Ard Ioc Comlha
description: Restores health to your group within 12 tiles, but not yourself.  Scales with WIS.

name: Blessed Intervention 1
description: Blesses you and your group within 12 tiles for 15s.  Next 10 hits each member takes will heal them.  Scales with WIS and max mana.  Damage over time does not count as a hit.

name: Dirge of Sorrow 1
description: Weakens enemies within 6 tiles, lowering their damage by 8% up to 12% at full harmony.  Slows the walk speed of monsters by 1/5 or more (including bosses).  Drains 250 mana + 1% of max each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Fortissimo 1
description: Strikes every enemy on the 8 tiles around you.  With with INT and max mana.

name: Hymn of Judgment 1
description: Strikes chosen tile and four tiles beside it with intense light.  Scales with INT and max mana.

name: Mesmerize 1
description: Melody that lulls the enemy to sleep for 14s.  The first hit that lands deals far more damage and wakes it.  Bosses are immune.

name: Song of Mending 1
description: A song that heals you and you group within 6 tiles for 3*WIS + 1% of their max health each second.  Anyone at full health gains a barrier instead (pets not affected).  Drains 250 mana + 1% of your max mana each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Song of the Bulwark 1
description: Restores 1% of the group's max mana each second, within 6 tiles.  Every 3s, removes one affliction from one member (suain, dall, cradh, miasma, poison, burn, amnesia or slow).  Drains 250 mana each second.  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).

name: Song of the March 1
description: Raises the Skill and Spell damage of your group within 6 tiles by 8%, and up to 12% at full harmony (assails and pets not affected).  Only one song may play at a time (cast it again to stop).  Answer its call to build harmony which strengthens it by up to half (Harmony fades if you stop answering).
